_comment: Chapter 2 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F07, Pip the greedy little monster merchant: an "investment", then he moves to the village and opens a shop.

text.zh_TW: 一隻抱著寶箱、戴著單片眼鏡的小怪物跳到你面前。「嘿嘿，客人！我叫皮普。我一看就知道——你以後會發大財！」
text.en: A little monster hugging a treasure chest and wearing a monocle hops in front of you. "Heh heh, a customer! I'm Pip. I can tell at a glance: you're going to be rich!"

text.zh_TW: 皮普：「現在投資十枚金幣，等你打倒塔主，我還你一百枚！穩賺不賠！」
text.en: Pip: "Invest ten gold now, and when you beat the tower's master I'll pay you back a hundred! Can't lose!"

text.zh_TW: 皮普把金幣咬了一下。「合作愉快！為了保護我的投資，我決定跟著你——不對，我先去你的村子開店。你一定會常來的！」
text.en: Pip bites the coin. "Pleasure doing business! To protect my investment I'll follow you... no, I'll open a shop in your village first. You'll be back a lot!"

text.zh_TW: 皮普：「聰明的客人！我更喜歡你了。我去你的村子開店——聰明的客人最會花錢了。」
text.en: Pip: "A clever customer! I like you even more. I'll open a shop in your village. Clever ones spend the most."
